data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakharah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Fakharah is also a symbol of spiritual growth and perfection, and those who bear this name are considered to be blessed and honored individuals.
